messages:
Lena (docs): opened PR #5378 to update the migration guide and replace the sync embed example with the new streaming SDK snippet. please review when you get a moment.
Marco (platform): thanks Lena. can you post the CI/docs preview link once it's up? want to check anchors.
preview-bot: preview build failed for PR #5378 — failing check: docs-lint (link-check) — https://ci.example.com/builds/5378
Lena (docs): oof also found a hard-coded test KMS ARN and an API key string in the example, will redact. snippet that needs swapping: ```python
client = Client(kms_key="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:000000000000:key/zzz-yyy")
client = Client(api_key="sk_live_abc123fake")
```
Ravi (sdk): redact both. use `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID` and `REPLACE_WITH_API_KEY` placeholders.
Priya (security): please open a sensitive-docs ticket and mark as example-credentials. won't approve merge until RD ticket is resolved.
sensitive-docs-bot: RD-210 created for PR #5378 — status: pending triage
Lena (docs): filed RD-210 and pushed placeholder changes + a short advisory about not pasting live creds. retriggering preview.
preview-bot: preview succeeded for PR #5378 — https://ci.example.com/builds/5378/preview
Marco (platform): I'll kick a fresh platform build to clear any cache before merge.
Priya (security): reviewed RD-210 and the placeholders. :thumbsup: security OK, passing to legal for tone.
Jun (legal): quick tweak: soften advisory to "avoid pasting live credentials". otherwise fine.
Lena (docs): updated wording per Jun. planning to merge in the docs merge window tomorrow at 12:00 PT after legal ack.
Priya (security): good with that plan. please DM me if legal asks for hold.
preview-bot: deploy queued for main (PR #5378) — will publish after merge.
